faq.a1: A cron job is a time-based job scheduler in Unix-like computer operating systems. Users can schedule jobs (commands or scripts) to run periodically at fixed times, dates, or intervals.
faq.q2: How do I install a cron job?
faq.a2: You typically use the command `crontab -e` in your terminal to edit your cron file. Then paste the generated line at the bottom of the file.
faq.a4: An asterisk means "every". For example, an asterisk in the minute field means "every minute".
